newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX products rally off lows on short covering.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX products rally off lows on short covering.

text.p: NYMEX heating oil and gasoline futures rallied off their lows at the close on Thursday in a flurry of short-covering ahead of the long Easter holiday.
The short covering showed up particularly in the April-May heating oil spreads amid position rolling ahead of the close of April contract on Monday.
NYMEX is closed on Friday due to the Easter holiday.
"Based on the strength of heating oil the entire market found good support," said Gerald Samuels of ARB Oil.
April heating oil ended up 0.64 at 56.07 a gallon.
NYMEX May crude oil futures closed up 6 cents at $20.70 a barrel, with key support levels pegged at $20.50 and $20.40 a barrel.
The unrest in Nigeria and a fear there would be a cut in production was more or less ignored by mostly bearish traders.

NYMEX April gasoline, which also expires Monday, popped up off its low of 63.65 cents to close down 0.19 at 64.63 cents a gallon. Traders also cited short covering in gasoline as a factor that helped bring the market higher.
The gasoline-to-crude crack spread closed at $6.44, compared to $6.37 on Wednesday.
